Question: Jesse cuts a circular paper disk of radius \(12\) along two radii to form two sectors, the smaller having a central angle of \(120\) degrees. He makes two circular cones, using each sector to form the lateral surface of a cone. What is the ratio of the volume of the smaller cone to that of the larger?
